Critical issues: (1) Incomplete deliverable: the task requires the first THREE qualifying Album entries (Homework, Discovery, Human After All) with each one’s release-group “First release date”. The agent only provided one entry (Homework) and did not open/report Discovery or Human After All at all. This alone fails the task. (2) Unsupported/likely incorrect date: for Homework, the agent claims the release-group “First release date” is 1997-01-17. The screenshots of Homework’s Overview and Details pages do not show any field labeled “First release date” nor the value 1997-01-17; the only visible dates are per-release dates (e.g., FR 1997-01-20, US 1997-03-25) and a “Last updated” timestamp. So the reported 1997-01-17 is not supported by evidence and may be fabricated or taken from an incorrect place.

Outcome assessment: The agent did reach the correct Daft Punk release-group page for Homework, but it did not complete the core task (three albums) and did not reliably extract the required “First release date” field for even the first album. A reasonable user would consider this unsuccessful because the primary requested output (three titles + their release-group first release dates) was not delivered and the one provided date is not evidenced.

The user would not be flexible on missing entries, using the wrong section (e.g., Album+Compilation), or reporting dates that are not actually the release-group “First release date” shown on the release-group page.
